from openpyxl import load_workbook

INPUT_FILE = "order_summary.xlsx"
OUTPUT_FILE = "order_summary_updated.xlsx"
ORDER_ID = "ORD-6C71B1"

workbook = load_workbook(INPUT_FILE)
matches = []

for worksheet in workbook.worksheets:
    for header_row in worksheet.iter_rows():
        headers = {}

        for cell in header_row:
            if cell.value is not None:
                headers[str(cell.value).strip().lower()] = cell.column

        order_column = None
        for name in ("order id", "order_id", "order number", "order"):
            if name in headers:
                order_column = headers[name]
                break

        status_column = headers.get("status")

        if order_column is None or status_column is None:
            continue

        for row_number in range(header_row[0].row + 1, worksheet.max_row + 1):
            value = worksheet.cell(row=row_number, column=order_column).value

            if str(value).strip().upper() == ORDER_ID:
                status_cell = worksheet.cell(
                    row=row_number,
                    column=status_column
                )
                matches.append((worksheet.title, row_number, status_cell))

        break

if not matches:
    workbook.close()
    raise RuntimeError("Order ORD-6C71B1 was not found.")

if len(matches) > 1:
    workbook.close()
    raise RuntimeError(
        "Order ORD-6C71B1 appears more than once; no file was saved."
    )

sheet_name, row_number, status_cell = matches[0]
old_status = str(status_cell.value).strip().lower()

if old_status != "cancelled":
    workbook.close()
    raise RuntimeError(
        "Order ORD-6C71B1 has status "
        + repr(status_cell.value)
        + ", not 'cancelled'."
    )

workbook.save(OUTPUT_FILE)
workbook.close()

    + "in sheet "
    + repr(sheet_name)
    + ", row "
    + str(row_number)
    + "."
)
